name: SPACE MARINES: LAND SPEEDER
description:
Land Speeders streak over the battlefield on humming anti-grav engines, performing blistering attack runs to rake the enemy with shots, and darting away before the foe can respond. They are valuable rapid reconnaissance assets for Space Marine forces in the field, and excel at providing highly mobile fire support.

Hit and Run

This multipart plastic kit builds a Land Speeder, a rapid response support vehicle for your Space Marines armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. The vehicle is armed with a multi-melta for slagging enemy armour at close range, a mighty onslaught gatling cannon for dealing with heavy infantry and light vehicles, and a stormfury missile launcher for some long-range punch. Able to keep up with the fastest elements of your army, Land Speeders fulfil several battlefield roles – use them to add heavy firepower to your assault, take on enemy armour, soften up tough units, or disrupt enemy plans with a threat they cannot ignore.

Customise Your Ride

The miniature's onslaught gatling cannon can be replaced with a pyrecannon to deal with hordes of light infantry, and the Land Speeder pilots each come with head options, allowing you to build them with a helmet or bare head. This miniature can be assembled either perched above a rocky outcrop, or positioned on a clear ball-jointed stem.

Contents:
– 44 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 105mm by 70mm Oval Hex Hole Base
– 1 Citadel 50mm Ball Flying Stem
– 1 Space Marine Vehicle Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Space Marine Vehicle Transfer Sheet features 329 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include symbols and icons for the Ultramarines, Imperial Fists, Salamanders, and Raptors, as well as vehicle designations, numbers, honour markings, and campaign badges to decorate your miniatures.

This push-fit miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour paints
